data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's reported gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year (prior-year comparative) was GBP 5.0967m. The report does not state an explicit gross prioryear (pre2014) movement amount. Narrative notes reference higher than anticipated claims notifications (notably a deterioration on the 2013 year of account) and IBNR as the critical reserving estimate, but no single gross prioryear movement figure is provided in the notes. A gross claims development table (presented in percentages and ultimate amounts) is included but does not provide a direct, unambiguous gross prioryear movement figure in the disclosures available.
raw_causal_phrases: Driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications, the 2013 year of account declares a loss on capacity of 5.9%.
The most critical estimate included within the syndicate's financial position is the estimate for losses incurred but not reported.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities technical provisions, prior-year comparative). No explicit gross "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" figure found. Gross claims development table is present (percentage development rows and ultimate amounts) but does not present the standard cumulative gross development triangle values needed to compute a clear prioryear movement; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross premium mix taken from the Managing Agent's divisional summary ('Life insurance' / 'Life reinsurance') because no regulatory segmental analysis with statutory class names was available. All amounts in the accounts are presented in GBP '000; values here converted to millions. No specific named catastrophe events or quantified prior-year impacts were identified in the report.
